AdminOps.sellersIntro: Storefronts on the marketplace, newest first. This screen reads: nothing here changes a storefront's status, because no authoritative writer for it exists yet.
AdminOps.sellerDetailIntro: One storefront, as an administrator reads it. It shows how the storefront stands and none of the owner's personal or contact details.
AdminOps.usersIntro: Accounts on the marketplace, newest first. Whether each contact channel was confirmed is shown; the contact itself is not.
AdminOps.userDetailIntro: One account, with the roles and the security record an administrator may read.
AdminOps.recoveryIntro: People locked out of their accounts, oldest first. Every decision here is taken by two different people, and never by the account holder.
AdminOps.recoveryDetailIntro: One recovery request, its evidence, and the one step you can take on it.
AdminOps.auditIntro: What was changed, when, and in which table. It records which columns changed, not what they changed to.
AdminOps.notFoundBody: This is not something you can open. It may not exist, or it may not be yours to see.
AdminOps.cursorTitle: That page could not be opened
AdminOps.cursorBody: The address carried a position that is no longer usable. Start again from the first page.
AdminOps.failed: That could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
AdminOps.conflict: Somebody has already moved this on. Reload to see where it stands.
AdminOps.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
AdminOps.needsAnother: Somebody other than you has to decide this one.
AdminOps.sellersEmptyBody: Nothing matches what you are looking at.
AdminOps.usersEmptyBody: Nothing matches what you are looking at.
AdminOps.rolesReadOnlyNote: Granting and removing roles is not available here: no authoritative writer for role assignment exists in this system yet, and the rules for one — which roles may be granted by whom, what happens to live sessions when one is removed — have not been agreed.
AdminOps.catalogueIntro: Every role, what it carries and how many people currently hold it. Reference only.
AdminOps.recoveryEmptyBody: No recovery request matches what you are looking at.
AdminOps.evidenceIntro: What was sent in support of this request. The files themselves are not readable from here.
AdminOps.ownRequestHint: This is your own account. Somebody else has to handle it.
AdminOps.isReviewerHint: You reviewed this request, so somebody else has to decide it.
AdminOps.awaitingContactHint: Waiting for the person to confirm their new contact with a one-time code. That step is theirs, not yours.
AdminOps.noStepHint: There is nothing to do on this request right now.
AdminOps.reviewIntro: Confirm that you have checked the documents against the claim. This fixes you as the reviewer, and somebody else will have to take the decision.
AdminOps.reviewConfirm: Record your review of this request? You will not be able to decide it afterwards.
AdminOps.decisionIntro: Approving moves it on to confirming the person's new contact. Rejecting closes it.
AdminOps.decisionConfirm: Record this decision? It cannot be retaken.
AdminOps.completionIntro: This ends every session on the account and holds withdrawals and payout changes for the configured period.
AdminOps.completionConfirm: Finish this recovery? Their sessions end immediately and the hold starts.
AdminOps.auditEmptyBody: No audit entry matches what you are looking at.
AdminOps.sellerTerminalNote: This storefront is closed. Closing is final here: there is no reopen, and nothing on this screen can change its status.
AdminOps.sellerVerificationNote: Verification is decided on the seller verification screen, not here. Activating a pending storefront follows its verification approval.
AdminOps.statusIntro: Only the moves this storefront can legally make are offered. Suspending it hides the storefront and every listing on it immediately; closing it is final.
AdminOps.reasonHint: Required when suspending. It is kept while the suspension lasts and cleared when the storefront is reinstated.
AdminOps.confirmSuspend: Suspend this storefront? It and every listing on it stop being publicly visible straight away, and the seller can no longer edit anything.
AdminOps.confirmClose: Close this storefront? This is final: there is no reopen from here.
AdminOps.confirmReinstate: Reinstate this storefront? It becomes visible again, along with its listings.
AdminOps.statusNotAllowed: That move is not available for this storefront. Reload to see where it stands.

Attributes.answerCount: {count, plural, =0 {No answers} one {# answer} other {# answers}}
Attributes.attached: This category now asks for it.
Attributes.attachedButHidden: Hidden, so nobody is asked it
Attributes.categoryCount: {count, plural, =0 {No categories ask it} one {# category asks it} other {# categories ask it}}
Attributes.categoryNote: The attributes sellers are asked about a listing in this category. Required is advisory for now: the field is marked and nothing refuses a listing for want of an answer.
Attributes.categoryReadOnlyNote: You can read what this category asks. Changing it needs permission to manage categories.
Attributes.createNote: The name and the kind of answer are fixed once given, because every answer already stored is typed by them. A new attribute is created hidden.
Attributes.createTagNote: The address is fixed once given. A tag is created ready to use.
Attributes.dataTypeHint: This is what every answer is checked against, and it can never be changed.
Attributes.detached: This category no longer asks for it. Every answer is kept.
Attributes.emptyBody: Nothing has been defined. Until an attribute exists, a category has no questions to ask and a listing carries only its title, description and price.
Attributes.failed: That could not be saved. Please try again.
Attributes.filterableHint: Recorded for later. Nothing filters by it yet.
Attributes.hiddenNow: It is hidden. Every answer is kept.
Attributes.identityNote: The name in the data and the kind of answer cannot be changed: every answer already stored refers to them. Hiding this attribute removes the field from sellers' forms and from public pages, and keeps every answer.
Attributes.invalidBody: That request could not be read.
Attributes.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. This is what every answer is stored against, and it can never be changed.
Attributes.keyTaken: That name is already in use, and a name cannot be changed once it has been given. Choose another.
Attributes.needsOption: Needs an option before it can be shown
Attributes.noCategoryAttributesBody: Sellers here are asked only for a title, a description and a price.
Attributes.noChoices: No attribute has been defined yet, or your access does not reach the vocabulary.
Attributes.noOptionsBody: This attribute cannot be shown until it has at least one option: a seller would be given a field with nothing to choose.
Attributes.noTagsBody: Nothing has been created. Sellers will see no tags to choose from.
Attributes.notAnswerable: That would leave sellers a question they cannot answer, or an answer they cannot give. A list needs at least one option before it is shown, and only a list has options.
Attributes.notFoundBody: There is nothing at this address, or your access does not reach it.
Attributes.optionCount: {count, plural, =0 {No options} one {# option} other {# options}}
Attributes.optionValueHint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. This is what answers refer to, and it can never be changed.
Attributes.optionsNote: What a seller may choose. An option's value is fixed once given; its labels are not. A hidden option cannot be chosen and stays on the listings that already chose it.
Attributes.pageIntro: An attribute is a question a category asks its sellers: the width of a table, whether a chair is assembled, which material something is made of. The vocabulary is defined here once and attached to as many categories as ask for it. A new attribute is hidden until it is ready, and nothing is ever deleted — hiding an attribute removes the field and keeps every answer.
Attributes.readOnlyNote: You can read this vocabulary. Changing it needs another permission.
Attributes.requiredHint: Sellers are told the field is required. Nothing refuses a listing for want of an answer in this release.
Attributes.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
Attributes.settingsNote: Labels, unit and ordering. Not the name sellers' answers are stored against, and not whether it is shown.
Attributes.tagSlugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. This is the tag's public address and can never be changed.
Attributes.tagsIntro: A tag is a free label a seller may put on a listing: handmade, vintage, imported. Tags are not a hierarchy and do not replace a category. A tag is usable the moment it exists, and retiring one hides it without touching the listings that already carry it.
Attributes.tagsNote: Every tag, including the hidden ones. The usage count is maintained by the database as listings are tagged.
Attributes.unavailable: The vocabulary could not be read. Please try again shortly.
Attributes.unitHint: Only a number has one. Leave it empty for none.
Attributes.valueNotAllowed: That value is longer or differently shaped than this field allows.
Attributes.vocabularyNote: Every attribute, including the hidden ones, in the order sellers are asked them.

Categories.clearHint: Leave a field empty to clear it. The name is always required.
Categories.createNote: The address is permanent and cannot be changed afterwards. A new category starts hidden until you name it and show it.
Categories.created: The category was created. It is hidden until you name it and show it.
Categories.emptyBody: Nothing has been created. Until a category exists, no seller can publish a listing and the public catalogue has nothing to show.
Categories.failed: That could not be saved. Please try again.
Categories.invalidBody: That request could not be read.
Categories.nameRequired: Name the category in at least one language first. A category that is shown must keep at least one.
Categories.notFoundBody: There is no category at this address, or your access does not reach it.
Categories.pageIntro: The category tree is what every listing hangs from: a seller cannot publish anything without choosing a category, and the public catalogue shows what is here. A category is created hidden, named in each language, and then shown.
Categories.readOnlyBody: Changing the catalogue needs a further permission, so nothing here can be edited with your access.
Categories.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
Categories.shadowed: Shown, but a category above it is hidden, so nobody can reach it.
Categories.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. This is permanent.
Categories.slugImmutable: The address is permanent. It cannot be changed, because nothing would redirect the old one.
Categories.slugTaken: Another category already uses that address.
Categories.stateNote: This is the only change a visitor notices. Hiding a category hides everything under it, and showing it again brings the branch back exactly as it was.
Categories.treeNotAllowed: That is not an allowed place in the tree. The tree is three levels deep, a category cannot sit under itself or anything below it, and a category with children has to have them moved first.
Categories.treeNote: Every category, including the hidden ones, in the order the public sees them. Up to three levels.
Categories.unavailable: The catalogue could not be read. Please try again shortly.
Categories.unwrittenBody: This category has no name yet, so it cannot be shown. Write at least one language below.
Categories.valueNotAllowed: One of those values is too long.

Cms.bodyHint: Plain text. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.
Cms.createFailed: The page could not be created.
Cms.createIntro: A new page is always a draft. Write it in at least one language before publishing it.
Cms.cursorBody: That page could not be opened. Start again from the first page.
Cms.detailIntro: One page: its address, its lifecycle and every language it has been written in.
Cms.emptyBody: Nothing has been authored so far.
Cms.indexableLabel: Allow search engines to index this page
Cms.invalid: Please check the fields and try again.
Cms.listIntro: Newest edit first. A page with no language cannot be published.
Cms.localeRequired: The page must be written in at least one language while it is published or scheduled.
Cms.noLocalesBody: This page has no text in any language, so it cannot be published.
Cms.notFoundBody: There is nothing here for this session.
Cms.pageIntro: The static pages the public site serves — about, help, the policies and the legal pages. Each one is a row here, so adding or renaming a page is an authoring action rather than a deployment.
Cms.pageKeyHint: Optional, stable identifier for a well-known page. Leave empty to clear it.
Cms.previousSlugsNote: Each of these redirects permanently to the current address and can never be reused by another page.
Cms.publicAddressNone: Not served by the public site
Cms.publicAddressNoneBody: The public site serves a fixed set of page addresses. Nothing is wrong with this page, but no visitor can reach it at this slug until the site is given a route for it.
Cms.publicAddressNoneTitle: This page has no public address
Cms.readOnlyBody: You can read this page but not change it.
Cms.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
Cms.settingsFailed: The changes could not be saved.
Cms.slugHint: Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens. This becomes the page's URL.
Cms.slugRenameHint: Changing this keeps the old address as a permanent redirect.
Cms.slugTaken: That address is already in use, or was previously used by another page.
Cms.statusFailed: The change could not be applied.
Cms.statusIntro: Publishing, scheduling, archiving and unpublishing. Which changes are allowed is decided by the platform, and a refused change says why.
Cms.transitionNotAllowed: That is not an allowed change for a page in its current state.
Cms.translationFailed: The language could not be saved.
Cms.translationRemoveConfirm: Press again to remove this language.
Cms.translationsIntro: Nothing is machine translated. A language exists because somebody wrote it; a page asked for in a language it lacks is served in English.
Cms.unavailable: This could not be loaded right now. Please try again.

Console.title: Console
Console.intro: The areas you have access to. Choose one to begin.
Console.languageFailed: The language could not be changed. Try again.
Console.signedOutBody: Sign in with your staff account to continue.
Console.stepUpBody: Staff access needs a second factor. Enter the code from your authenticator app to continue.
Console.forbiddenBody: This area is not available for your account.
Console.unavailableBody: We could not check your access just now. Try again shortly.
Console.emptyBody: Your account has no console areas. Ask an administrator if you think this is wrong.
Console.comingSoon: The tools for this area arrive in a later step. Nothing is missing from your account.

Disputes.queueIntro: Disputes between a buyer and a seller about one order, oldest first — somebody is out of pocket while a dispute waits.
Disputes.detailIntro: What is claimed and why, the order it is about, and the exchange so far.
Disputes.boundaryNote: Recording a decision here settles the dispute and puts the order back where it was. It does not move money: a refund decision records that a refund is owed, and paying it is a separate step that is not part of this console.
Disputes.deferredNote: Attaching or reading evidence, assigning a dispute and changing its due date are not available yet. Only two dispute states are reachable, so no other state is offered as a filter.
Disputes.notFoundBody: There is nothing here for this session.
Disputes.cursorTitle: That page could not be opened
Disputes.cursorBody: Start again from the first page.
Disputes.failed: That could not be recorded. Try again.
Disputes.conflict: This dispute has changed since the page loaded. Reload it and look again.
Disputes.signedOut: The session has ended. Sign in again.
Disputes.isPartyHint: You are a party to this dispute, so somebody else has to rule on it.
Disputes.isPartyNote: You are the buyer or the seller on this dispute. A colleague who is not a party has to rule on it. You can still add a message.
Disputes.isPartyRefusal: Nobody rules on a dispute they are a party to. A colleague has to take this one.
Disputes.internalIsParty: You are a party to this dispute, so you cannot leave a staff-only note on it. An ordinary message is fine.
Disputes.resolvedByMeHint: You recorded the decision on this dispute.
Disputes.readOnlyNote: You can read this dispute. Adding a message and recording a decision need a further permission.
Disputes.closedNote: This dispute is settled. Its thread is closed and the decision cannot be retaken.
Disputes.messageIntro: A message both parties can read, or a note only staff can see.
Disputes.internalLabel: Staff only — the buyer and the seller cannot see this
Disputes.internalHint: Leave this off and both parties will read it. A staff note is never shown to either of them.
Disputes.confirmVisible: Add this message? The buyer and the seller will both be able to read it, and it cannot be edited or withdrawn.
Disputes.confirmInternal: Add this as a staff-only note? Neither party will see it, and it cannot be edited or withdrawn.
Disputes.threadClosed: This dispute is settled and its thread takes no more messages.
Disputes.refundDecidedNotMoved: This records that a refund is owed. No money has moved: paying it is a separate step that is not part of this console.
Disputes.resolveIntro: Every decision is recorded with its reason, settles the dispute and puts the order back to where it was before. A decision cannot be retaken.
Disputes.noMoneyNotice: This records that a refund is owed. It does not pay it: no refund is created and no money moves. Paying it is a separate step that is not part of this console.
Disputes.reasonHint: Kept with the dispute. Required for every decision.
Disputes.amountHint: Digits only, in the order’s smallest unit — 1500 means 15.00. Optional; leave it empty to record the decision without an amount.
Disputes.amountInvalid: An amount is digits only and greater than zero.
Disputes.confirmRefund: Record this decision? It settles the dispute and puts the order back where it was. It records that a refund is owed and moves no money.
Disputes.confirmRelease: Record this decision? It settles the dispute in the seller’s favour and puts the order back where it was.
Disputes.confirmNoAction: Record this decision? It settles the dispute without finding for either side and puts the order back where it was.
Disputes.alreadyResolved: This dispute has already been settled, either by you or by a colleague. Reload the page.
Disputes.amountNotAllowed: An amount belongs only to a refund decision.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.identifierHint: Use the email address or phone number on your account.
Login.incomplete: Enter your email or phone number and your password.

Moderation.reportsIntro: Reports waiting to be looked at, oldest first. Priority is shown as the reporter's surface recorded it and is not a ranking.
Moderation.notFoundBody: There is nothing here for you.
Moderation.cursorTitle: That page could not be opened
Moderation.cursorBody: Start again from the first page.
Moderation.subjectUnavailable: This kind of subject has no staff view in this console, so there is nothing to show here.
Moderation.ownReportHint: You reported this, so somebody else has to decide it.
Moderation.ownListingHint: This is your own listing, so somebody else has to decide it.
Moderation.alreadyDecidedHint: This report has been decided. A decision is not reopened or edited; a further decision about the subject is recorded on the subject itself.
Moderation.decideHint: A decision cannot be undone and a report is never reopened.
Moderation.decideNoteHint: Required for anything but triage. It stays inside the console.
Moderation.decideNoteRequired: A report is never closed without a reason.
Moderation.decideDuplicateHint: The identifier of the report this one repeats.
Moderation.decideDuplicateRequired: A duplicate names the report it duplicates.
Moderation.decideQuestion: Record this decision? It cannot be undone.
Moderation.moderateHint: The decision is recorded with its reason and cannot be edited afterwards.
Moderation.moderateReasonHint: Recorded with the decision, up to five hundred characters.
Moderation.moderateReasonRequired: A decision is always recorded with its reason.
Moderation.moderateReasonTooLong: That is longer than five hundred characters.
Moderation.moderateQuestion: Record this decision? It cannot be undone.
Moderation.failedNotFound: That is no longer available to you.
Moderation.failedAlreadyFinal: Somebody has already decided this report. Reload to see the decision.
Moderation.failedOwnReport: You reported this, so somebody else has to decide it.
Moderation.failedOwnListing: This is your own listing, so somebody else has to decide it.
Moderation.failedNoChange: Somebody has already done this. Reload to see the listing's current state.
Moderation.failedNotApplicable: This listing cannot take that action: it has no price, or it was never approved.
Moderation.failedInvalid: That could not be recorded. Check what you chose and try again.
Moderation.failedSignedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
Moderation.failedGeneric: That could not be recorded. Please try again.

Platform.pageIntro: What the platform runs on a schedule, whether that schedule still matches what was agreed, and what the transactional outbox is holding. Everything here is read-only: the workers own every write to a job run and to an event.
Platform.runDetailIntro: One recorded run, with the scheduled job it belongs to.
Platform.notFoundBody: There is nothing here for this session.
Platform.cursorTitle: That page could not be opened
Platform.cursorBody: Start again from the first page.
Platform.readOnlyNote: This section is read-only. Jobs and queued events are written only by the platform’s own workers, so there is no retry, cancel, requeue or re-run here — and no route behind one.
Platform.scheduleIntro: Every job the database schedules, with the expression it runs on, the function it calls and the purpose recorded for it.
Platform.workerJobsNote: These are the database’s scheduled jobs. The worker’s repeatable jobs record no run yet, so none of them appears here.
Platform.scheduleEmptyBody: The schedule is empty, which is itself worth looking into.
Platform.problemsNone: The schedule matches the contract: nothing is missing, misscheduled, pointed elsewhere or switched off.
Platform.outboxIntro: Every business side effect starts as a committed row here. Counts and ages only — no event, no payload and nothing identifying what any event is about.
Platform.noRelayNote: No relay and no sweeper are running yet, so nothing drains this queue: a large pending count and an old oldest-pending time are expected here and are not a relay failing.
Platform.deadLettersGroupedNote: Grouped by kind rather than listed: identifying each event would mean naming the order, conversation or account it is about, and there is nothing to act on here.
Platform.runsIntro: Every run the platform has recorded, most recent first.
Platform.uncontractedNote: The schedule no longer names this job, so there is no expression, target or purpose to show. The run itself is kept.
Platform.noMessageNote: The failure text is not shown here. The job runner stores it as a raw database error, which quotes the row that caused it, so it is read from the database rather than from this console.

Reviews.queueIntro: Reviews buyers left on completed orders, newest first. A decision recorded here is final: the automatic reassessment that hides reviews on refunded or disputed orders leaves a review a person has ruled on alone.
Reviews.detailIntro: What was written, what state it is in, and the seller’s answer beside it.
Reviews.notFoundBody: There is nothing here for this session.
Reviews.cursorTitle: That page could not be opened
Reviews.cursorBody: Start again from the first page.
Reviews.failed: That could not be recorded. Try again.
Reviews.conflict: This review has changed since the page loaded. Reload it and look again.
Reviews.signedOut: The session has ended. Sign in again.
Reviews.moderatedByMeHint: You recorded the last decision on this review.
Reviews.isPartyHint: You are a party to this review, so somebody else has to rule on it.
Reviews.isPartyNote: You are the buyer or the seller on this review. A colleague who is not a party has to rule on it.
Reviews.isPartyRefusal: Nobody rules on a review they are a party to. A colleague has to take this one.
Reviews.replyReadOnlyNote: Shown so the whole exchange can be read. A reply’s own state cannot be changed from this console.
Reviews.replyGapNote: Hiding or removing a review also hides the seller’s reply, because a reply is public only while its review is. There is no way to act on a reply alone yet.
Reviews.decisionIntro: Every decision is recorded with its reason, and a decision stands: after one is recorded, a refund or a dispute on the order no longer hides the review.
Reviews.decisionStatusLabel: Where this review should end up
Reviews.reasonHint: Kept with the review. Required for every decision, including re-affirming the state it is already in.
Reviews.confirmPublish: Publish this review? It counts towards the storefront’s rating again, and a refund or dispute on the order will no longer hide it.
Reviews.confirmHide: Hide this review? It stops counting towards the storefront’s rating, and the seller’s reply goes with it.
Reviews.confirmRemove: Remove this review? It stops counting towards the storefront’s rating, and the seller’s reply goes with it.
Reviews.confirmPending: Send this review back for moderation? It stops counting towards the storefront’s rating while it waits.

publicationBlock.order_refunded: The order behind this review was refunded, which is why the automatic reassessment would hide it.
publicationBlock.payment_disputed: The payment for this order is disputed, which is why the automatic reassessment would hide it.

SeoRedirects.activateConfirm: Press again to switch it on. Visitors to that address will be sent elsewhere immediately.
SeoRedirects.activeHint: Leave this unticked to add the entry without it redirecting anybody yet.
SeoRedirects.chainBody: A visitor takes more than one hop. Pointing this entry straight at the final address is faster and easier to follow.
SeoRedirects.createFailed: The redirect could not be added.
SeoRedirects.createIntro: Both addresses are paths on this site. A new entry starts switched off, so you can check it before it affects anybody.
SeoRedirects.cursorBody: That page of the map could not be read. Go back to the first page.
SeoRedirects.detailIntro: One entry: where it points, whether it is switched on, and where its chain actually ends.
SeoRedirects.editFailed: The changes could not be saved.
SeoRedirects.emptyBody: No redirect has been added yet. Addresses that no longer exist answer 404.
SeoRedirects.fromHint: A path on this site, beginning with a slash — for example /old-offer.
SeoRedirects.fromRenameHint: Changing this frees the old address, which then goes back to being a 404.
SeoRedirects.invalid: Check the addresses and try again.
SeoRedirects.listIntro: Newest edit first. An entry that is switched off is kept and audited and redirects nobody.
SeoRedirects.loopBody: Following it comes back to the address it started from, so the site ignores it rather than sending a visitor round in circles. Change the destination.
SeoRedirects.noMatchesBody: No entry matches that search or that state. Clear the filters to see the whole map.
SeoRedirects.notAllowed: That is not an allowed redirect. Both addresses must be paths on this site, they must differ, and the status code must be 301, 302, 307 or 308.
SeoRedirects.notFoundBody: There is no such entry, or it is not one you may open.
SeoRedirects.noteClearHint: Clearing this field removes the note.
SeoRedirects.pageIntro: Where an address that no longer exists sends a visitor. Every entry is a path on this site pointing at another path on this site.
SeoRedirects.pathTaken: Another redirect already starts from that address. Edit that entry instead of adding a second one.
SeoRedirects.precedenceBody: The site answers a live page, listing, service or static page itself. An entry is only consulted for an address that would otherwise be a 404, so a redirect from an address that still works will appear to do nothing.
SeoRedirects.readOnlyBody: Changing the redirect map needs a separate permission.
SeoRedirects.readOnlyTitle: You may read this, not change it
SeoRedirects.removeConfirm: Press again to remove it. This cannot be undone from here.
SeoRedirects.resolvedNone: Nowhere — this entry redirects nobody as it stands
SeoRedirects.searchHint: Matches either address, as plain text. A percent sign or an underscore matches that character.
SeoRedirects.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
SeoRedirects.stateHeading: Switch it on, off, or remove it
SeoRedirects.stateIntro: Switching off stops the redirect and keeps the entry. Removing it cannot be undone from here, although the audit trail keeps what it said.
SeoRedirects.statusHint: 301 and 308 are permanent and are what search engines act on. 302 and 307 are temporary.
SeoRedirects.toHint: Another path on this site. A query string is allowed. Addresses on other sites are not.
SeoRedirects.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.

ServiceRequests.emptyBody: No service request matches this filter right now.
ServiceRequests.notFoundBody: This request is not available. It may have been removed, or it may not be one the marketplace team handles.
ServiceRequests.cursorTitle: That page could not be opened
ServiceRequests.cursorBody: Start again from the first page of the queue.
ServiceRequests.paymentDescriptiveOnly: What the buyer wrote about paying, in their own words. Descriptive only: no payment is taken here, and none of this reaches a payment provider. Both fields are cleared 90 days after the request closes.
ServiceRequests.paymentPurged: This information was cleared 90 days after the request closed. The request itself is unchanged.
ServiceRequests.paymentUnavailable: This could not be read just now. Try again.
ServiceRequests.noSellerNote: No seller is involved in this request and no quote can be made on it. There is no checkout, order or payment attached to it.
